

```{python}
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import os

```

```{python}
folder = "/Users/mateoflores/Documents/Tec/ProjectMultivariados/fotomascotas"
```

```{python}
n = 4
height = 64
width = 64
```

```{python}
images = np.empty(shape = (n, height, width), dtype = "float")
```

```{python}
import cv2

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    img_path = os.path.join(folder, "maya" + str(i) + ".jpg")
    img = cv2.imread(img_path)
    image = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    resized_image = cv2.resize(image, (width, height))
    images[i - 1, :, :] = resized_image
```

```{python}
images.shape
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize = (8, 8))
for i in range(n):
    plt.subplot(2, 2, i + 1)
    plt.title("Maya " + str(i + 1))
    plt.imshow(images[i], cmap = "gray")
    plt.axis("off")
```

```{python}
X = images.reshape(images.shape[0], -1)
64 * 64
```

```{python}
X.shape
```

```{python}
X_bar = X.mean(axis = 0)
```

```{python}
X_star = X - X_bar
```

```{python}
U, D, Vt = np.linalg.svd(X_star.T, full_matrices = False)
```

```{python}
idx = D.argsort()[::-1]
D = D[idx]
U = U[:, idx]
Vt = Vt[:, idx]
```

```{python}
loadings = U
```

```{python}
explained_variance = D**2 / (n - 1)
```

```{python}
explained_variance < explained_variance.mean()
```

```{python}
q = 2
E = U[:, :q]
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize = (10, 10))
for i in range(q):
    eigenface = E[:, i].reshape(64, 64).astype("float")
    plt.subplot(1, q, i + 1)
    plt.title("EigenMaya " + str(i + 1))
    plt.imshow(eigenface, cmap = "gray")
    plt.axis("off")
plt.show();
```

```{python}
Z = X_star @ E
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame(Z, columns = ["PC1", "PC2"])
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

sns.scatterplot(df,
                x = "PC1",
                y = "PC2",
                color = "dodgerblue")
plt.title("Maya en menor dimensión")
plt.show();
```

```{python}
X_hat = Z @ E.T + X_bar
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize = (8, 8))
for i in range(n):
    eigenface = X_hat[i, :].reshape(64, 64).astype("float")
    plt.subplot(2, 2, i + 1)
    plt.title("Maya reconstruida " + str(i + 1))
    plt.imshow(eigenface, cmap = "gray")
    plt.axis("off")
plt.show();
```

```{python}
explained_variance_ratio = explained_variance / explained_variance.sum()
```

```{python}
PCs = np.arange(len(explained_variance)) + 1
```

```{python}
plt.plot(PCs, explained_variance_ratio, "o-",
         linewidth = 2, color = "dodgerblue")
plt.xticks(PCs)
plt.title("Scree plot")
plt.xlabel("PC")
plt.ylabel("Proporción de varianza explicada")
plt.show();
```
